 4 more die of dengue, 1,900 hospitalised in 24 hours
 All four deaths reported from Dhaka division; this year's death toll rises to 478 
 Published : 11 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 11 November 2026, 16:53
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least four dengue patients died and 1,900 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 All four deaths were reported from Dhaka division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest fatalities, the death toll from dengue this year has risen to 478, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,55,668.
 Currently, 6,067 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
